lessonTitle: 33. The notion of a square root
lessonTitleEnglish: The notion of a square root
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: A square root of a is a number whose square is a; the square roots of 9 are 3 and −3.
stages.headlineEnglish: A square root of a is a number whose square is a; the square roots of 9 are 3 and −3.

stages.headline: A negative number has no square root, since squares are never negative; the only root of 0 is 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: A negative number has no square root, since squares are never negative; the only root of 0 is 0.

stages.headline: The solutions of x² = a are the square roots of a: where the parabola y = x² meets the line y = a.
stages.headlineEnglish: The solutions of x² = a are the square roots of a: where the parabola y = x² meets the line y = a.
